I built a personalized signal play for GAN Integrity off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

New AI product lifts demand faster than the team can ramp to cover it. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings GAN Integrity needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to GAN Integrity's motion? I will tailor it to you either way.
